Legal

Regulatory Disclosure

Effective: January 1, 2025

Regulatory Authority

SEBI

Securities and Exchange Board of India

Platform Operator

AlternaVest Capital

AlternaVest Capital Management LLP

1. Platform Nature

The Sovereign Ledger is an information and discovery platform for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). AlternaVest Capital Management LLP is a technology and financial information intermediary. We are not a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser, Portfolio Manager, or Stock Broker.

2. SEBI Registration Status of Listed Funds

All Alternative Investment Funds featured on this platform are, to the best of our knowledge, registered with SEBI under the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012. Registration with SEBI does not guarantee performance or protect against losses. Investors must independently verify the registration status of any fund by checking the SEBI SCORES portal or contacting SEBI directly.

3. No Offer of Securities

Information presented on this platform does not constitute an offer or invitation to subscribe to any securities. Any investment in an AIF is subject to the terms of the applicable Private Placement Memorandum (PPM) and Contribution Agreement, which supersede any information on this platform.

4. Applicable Regulations

gavel

5. Investor Grievance Redressal

For complaints against any fund manager or AIF registered with SEBI, investors may use:

SEBI SCORES Portal

6. Data Sources & Accuracy

Performance data and fund information are sourced from fund managers, regulatory filings, and publicly available disclosures. While we strive for accuracy, AlternaVest does not warrant the completeness or timeliness of any information. Always refer to official fund documents for investment decisions.
